name: Refinishing Fir Floors in Old Seattle Homes: An Owner's Guide
title-tag: Refinishing Fir Floors in Old Seattle Homes | OC Flooring
meta-description: Old-growth Douglas fir in your Craftsman or bungalow? Why fir punishes rough sanding, why natural beats stain, and what refinishing costs in Seattle.
post-summary: August 28, 2026 · The fir under your Craftsman's carpet is old-growth wood that can't be bought anymore — and it refinishes beautifully if the crew respects how soft it is. Why gentle sanding matters twice as much at 660 Janka, why stain blotches and natural wins, how reclaimed-board repairs disappear, and what it all costs in Seattle.
